summary: Official Ya'an and Sichuan sources establish a local property-registration custodian and registration procedures, but no anonymous public parcel ID plus geometry response was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese discovery queries are recorded in city-6322-ya-an.json. Results identified the official Ya'an Natural Resources and Planning Bureau, the municipal Property Registration Center notice, and the Sichuan service listing.
requestOutcomes: The Sichuan official service page and Ya'an municipal notice were available as public first-party evidence. The Ya'an Natural Resources and Planning Bureau host timed out on a bounded anonymous GET, while one municipal department URL encountered a redirect loop. No public viewer/API schema, CRS, or safe parcel-ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields or TLS-disable action was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [29.9938059920299, 103.000840912365] was preserved; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No Ya'an city boundary or complete city coverage was established for an open geometry service.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, source schema or CRS was retrieved or retained.
Official registration custody/procedure evidence is not treated as proof of an open vector parcel API.
A timeout, redirect loop, inaccessible viewer or absent public endpoint is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
